overview: The City Council ordained a significant rezoning for the Medford Square District and authorized funding for multiple school infrastructure projects, including MSBA feasibility studies for two elementary schools. The Council also voted to file a formal public records request for a litigation report following the administration's failure to provide a requested summary of legal expenses.

items.title: Ceremonial Resolutions and Memorials
items.summary: The Council commemorated the life of activist Judy Kaplan and celebrated 18 youth volunteers from St. Raphael Parish for building beds for children in need.

items.title: Minutes and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved meeting records from March and April 2026 and accepted committee reports regarding residential tax exemptions, Boston Avenue rezoning, and the fiscal year 2027 preliminary budget.

items.title: MSBA School Projects and High School Update
items.summary: Approved a $400,000 appropriation from the Capital Stabilization Fund for feasibility studies and schematic designs for roof and heat pump projects at Missituk and Brooks Elementary Schools. School officials provided an update on the Medford High School project, noting that six design options are being narrowed down to one by June 2026.

items.title: Medford Public Schools Capital Improvement Plan
items.summary: Approved funding for various school repairs, including fire alarm studies, network refreshes, and accessibility upgrades at the McGlynn, Andrews, and Brooks schools.

items.title: Unpaid Prior Year School Department Bill
items.summary: Approved paying $48,866.17 from the current budget for overdue electrical and fire alarm invoices from fiscal year 2025 due to past administrative processing errors.

items.title: Medford Square District Rezoning
items.summary: Ordained the new Medford Square District Zoning Ordinance and Map after 16 public meetings, establishing new height limits and incentives for historic preservation and transit-oriented development.

items.title: Standard Compensation Ordinance
items.summary: Approved for first reading an ordinance to establish standard compensation and labor floors for contracted custodial and security services.

items.title: Public Records Request for Litigation Report
items.summary: Voted to file a formal public records request for a comprehensive report on all city legal matters since 2019 after the administration failed to respond to a previous resolution. Members of the public informed the Council that residents have intervened in federal court to defend city ordinances they believe the administration may not adequately represent.

items.title: Common Victualler License Compliance
items.summary: Referred to the Administration and Finance Committee an update regarding 11 businesses operating without valid 2026 licenses and discussed creating a fee schedule for non-compliance.

items.title: Community Preservation Act and Personnel Adjustments
items.summary: Approved the $2.38 million CPA budget reserve for fiscal 2027 and $4,000 for the Tufts Park garden expansion; separately, the Council approved a first reading of personnel amendments to reclassify the directors of elections, DEI, and veteran services.

items.title: Legal Settlement: Subro-IQ
items.summary: Approved a $3,414.38 settlement for a motor vehicle accident involving a Fire Department employee.
